summary: The topbar bell was renamed Events -> Notifications and rewired from vision-only to the unified persisted notification store (GET /api/notifications), so it now surfaces every source: AI detection (vision-monitor), Camera Health, Machine Health, Login Security, and Settings. A dedicated Notifications page (new top-level tab) owns its own paged/filtered fetch (All/Unread + type chips, server-side via new category+source params on List); AI rows are rich — annotated event screenshot, detection fields, Acknowledge, and an in-page 'View clip' video popup when a recording segment exists (or 'No clip recorded' once past the flush grace). The unread badge is now server-truth (List total unread, refreshed on mount, the 15s poll, and the SSE notification event) rather than a client counter, and opening the panel no longer zeroes it. Acknowledging an alert now also dismisses its bell notification at the source: the acknowledge handler calls notifier.MarkReadByRef(alert_event, alertId) (new on domain notification.Service + INotificationService). Recording's redundant 'Event Clips' sub-tab was removed (All Recordings + the Notifications page cover it); live-tile 'open alerts' and test-alerts now route to the Notifications page.
compatibility: Backward compatible at the API level (the unified store was already populated by notifier.Publish). Behaviour change: the bell reads /api/notifications instead of /api/vision/alerts; acked alerts now reliably clear their notification (previously a leftover unread notification could stick). The Recording 'Event Clips' sub-tab is gone — browse/play event clips under All Recordings or the Notifications page.
